title: Improve conditional kappa to 0.00329492 with a rebalanced retirement tree
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Conditional κ increases from 0.00329394 ([PR6545](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6545)) to 0.00329492: +0.00000098, or +0.0297516%.** This is the incremental gain over the strongest public proposal checked for this contribution. Inherited gains are excluded. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Keep PR6545's independent Gaussian retirement and PR6529's native word. Rebalance the four binary children from `(7,2,2,7)` to `(7,2,5,4)`. The first 329 events and the retirement bases are unchanged. The full signed invoice gains `208[(H41−H40)−(H57−H56)]`, strictly positive for `H_r=r^t`, `0<t<1`, by the decreasing derivative. This changes the construction and invoice; it does not just refine the old root's decimal value.

All 18 native calls, 17 thin queries, 13,756 productive fields and 67,096 paid Gaussian jobs remain. The 35-field caller has 611 events instead of 609. Both paid and productive rank mass fall by 832; the surplus remains 760. The two extra ordinary translations are included in the complete 254,932,208-operation upper bound, below the retained 10^9 allowance.

Start with the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/11ca568cd1a16776ade02b4df09ea04a784cc674/research/retirement-rebalanced-query-tree/PROOF.md), [complete receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/11ca568cd1a16776ade02b4df09ea04a784cc674/research/retirement-rebalanced-query-tree/RESULT.json), [tree data](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/11ca568cd1a16776ade02b4df09ea04a784cc674/research/retirement-rebalanced-query-tree/ROOT.json) and [literal caller](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/11ca568cd1a16776ade02b4df09ea04a784cc674/research/retirement-rebalanced-query-tree/CONTROLLER.json).

## Task and overlap

Base: canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8. The explicit user task asks for another κ improvement of any size. Card `p104-side-correction` is marked **changed**: the exact published retirement makes a different caller tree profitable. This contribution supplies the changed arbitrary-input caller and complete price.

Immediate source: PR6545 at `775722aa94a5e85b05d1d704d7dca10cbf016f0c`. Its native source is PR6529 at `44b0d0e8961201ac1656490b4384a7752e1cd9c5`; replay services are PR6524 at `dd1a979bfff090fa6559cc3b7d4e7f5ab24b4f80`. Exact sources, proofs and notices are retained with original paths, Git blobs and SHA256 values. No side-branch history or network fetch is needed for scientific replay.

[Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5645#discussioncomment-19205459). PR6545 had released its continuation, including retirement-aware price screens. This uses its published identity and claims no new retirement mechanism or global caller optimum. The other fixed-native contact search remains separate. The earlier full cache covered 497 open PRs and 6,487 Discussion records; live source claims, hubs and updated PRs through #6550 were checked again before submission. Canonical main and PR6545's head are unchanged. Unpublished work, arbitrary diffs and sparse historical notes remain coverage limits.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.13, standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/retirement-rebalanced-query-tree
```

Normal and optimized registered replay pass. The verifier regenerates the complete native source, checks all 799 native columns and absolute phases, replays PR6545 and matches every frozen result, then checks all 1,225 new caller coefficients with forward and reverse engines. Exact dual pairs, all 7,488 physical contacts, the complete invoice, two rational moment engines, compiler and all 58 outer predicates pass. Thirteen new caller/invoice rejection controls and four source-corruption controls pass, alongside the retained controls.

The raw crossing is enclosed in `(0.00329492611057136286764342, 0.00329492611057136286764343)`; tested saving is `.003294925`. Both rational engines reject the complete PR6545 invoice at the new claim. Its old tail decay fails here, so the new price uses decay 97/100 and reserve 10^(-27), at the same power 1920. All tail tests pass.

All 17 final committed files pass byte/mode checks. The official export passes integrity and declared-input checks. Normal and optimized direct replay pass from a read-only export with no Git metadata and an empty PATH; all 18 exported files, including metadata, remain unchanged. The final commit only updates the validation record after that replay. [Hosted CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41586874492) passed at head `11ca568cd1a16776ade02b4df09ea04a784cc674`: 711 helper tests, both complete registered scientific replays and unchanged committed inputs. Completed logs were read once. GitHub's synthetic test tree matches the published/local tree; no actual merge occurred. See [validation details](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/11ca568cd1a16776ade02b4df09ea04a784cc674/research/retirement-rebalanced-query-tree/VALIDATION.md).

The five inherited assumptions remain: native all-column behavior, owned erasure, compiler closure, precision/tape bounds and analytic recovery. Independent scientific review, formal-kernel verification and a materialized complete integer multiplier remain open. The optional full-history preflight is not claimed in this shallow checkout. No merge, closure or selected-result edit is included.

## Credit

Credit PR6545's retirement, PR5599/5602/5611/5615's handoff and basis methods, PR6348/6398's binary suppliers and mixed root, PR6529's native word and PR6524's replay services. Retain Rohan Arun, Erwan L., DreamingOfClouds, Cinna Davis, David Arias, Gareth Davidson, Jacob Alan Sussman, zxv, Cao Yifan, ywz65, Nick Petalas and all archived predecessor notices.

## Open next questions

The smallest follow-up is independent review of the unchanged prefix, equal target group and exact invoice delta. [Structured next questions](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/11ca568cd1a16776ade02b4df09ea04a784cc674/research/retirement-rebalanced-query-tree/README.md#open-next-questions) also identify the missing exact caller needed for a larger gain. No broader construction scope is reserved.
